def attach_a2a_routes_to_app(
    app: Any,
    *,
    agent_card: Any,
    agent_executor: Any,
    task_store: Any,
    enable_v0_3_compat: bool = True,
    push_config_store: Any = None,
    prefix: str = "",
) -> None:
  """Wires an A2A agent executor into an existing Starlette app.

  ``prefix`` mounts both the JSON-RPC route and the agent-card well-known route
  under ``{prefix}`` so that multiple agents hosted on one app do not collide
  on the default ``/`` RPC route and ``/.well-known/...`` card route.
  """
  if IS_A2A_V1:
    from a2a.server.request_handlers import DefaultRequestHandler
    from a2a.server.routes import create_agent_card_routes
    from a2a.server.routes import create_jsonrpc_routes

    handler_factory = cast(Callable[..., Any], DefaultRequestHandler)
    handler = handler_factory(
        agent_executor=agent_executor,
        task_store=task_store,
        push_config_store=push_config_store,
        agent_card=agent_card,
    )
    rpc_url = prefix or "/"
    # Mount the agent-card well-known route under the same prefix as the
    # RPC route so multiple agents hosted on one app don't collide on the
    # default ``/.well-known/agent-card.json`` path.
    card_url = (
        f"{prefix.rstrip('/')}/.well-known/agent-card.json"
        if prefix
        else "/.well-known/agent-card.json"
    )
    app.routes.extend([
        *create_agent_card_routes(agent_card, card_url=card_url),
        *create_jsonrpc_routes(
            handler,
            rpc_url,
            enable_v0_3_compat=enable_v0_3_compat,
        ),
    ])
  else:
    del enable_v0_3_compat  # Only consumed by the v1.x route factory.

    try:
      from a2a.utils.constants import AGENT_CARD_WELL_KNOWN_PATH
    except ImportError:
      AGENT_CARD_WELL_KNOWN_PATH = "/.well-known/agent-card.json"

    handler_factory = cast(Callable[..., Any], DefaultRequestHandler)
    handler = handler_factory(
        agent_executor=agent_executor,
        task_store=task_store,

    )

      )

"""
A2A (Agent-to-Agent) package for PitWall AI.
"""

"""
Shared Thread-Safe Disk-Backed Artifact Store for PitWall AI A2A Architecture.
Keyed by UUID dataset_id with TTL cleanup.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import time
from typing import Any
import uuid

import pandas as pd

logger = logging.getLogger("pitwall.a2a.artifact_store")

DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DIR = Path("./data/artifacts")


class ArtifactStore:
    """Thread-safe disk-backed store for large datasets (telemetry, SQL results, stints)."""

    def __init__(self, storage_dir: Path | str | None = None):
        self.storage_dir = Path(storage_dir) if storage_dir else DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DIR
        self.storage_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._lock = threading.RLock()

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Any) -> Any:
        """Convert DataFrames or non-standard structures to JSON-serializable structures."""
        if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
            return {
                "__type__": "dataframe",
                "records": json.loads(data.to_json(orient="records", date_format="iso")),
                "columns": list(data.columns),
            }
        return data

    def _deserialize_data(self, data: Any) -> Any:
        """Restore structures if tagged with custom type or return as-is."""
        if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("__type__") == "dataframe":
            return pd.DataFrame(data.get("records", []))
        return data

    def put(
        self,
        data: Any,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        dataset_id: str | None = None,
        ttl_seconds: int = 3600,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Store a dataset on disk with metadata and TTL.
        Returns the dataset_id.
        """
        if not dataset_id:
            dataset_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

        now = time.time()
        expires_at = now + ttl_seconds if ttl_seconds > 0 else 0

        record = {
            "dataset_id": dataset_id,
            "created_at": now,
            "expires_at": expires_at,
            "metadata": metadata or {},
            "data": self._serialize_data(data),
        }

        file_path = self.storage_dir / f"{dataset_id}.json"
        with self._lock:
            # Write to a temp file and rename for atomic write
            temp_path = self.storage_dir / f"{dataset_id}.tmp"
            with open(temp_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(record, f, default=str)
            if temp_path.exists():
                temp_path.replace(file_path)

        logger.debug(f"Artifact stored: dataset_id={dataset_id}, expires_in={ttl_seconds}s")
        return dataset_id

    def get(self, dataset_id: str, as_dataframe: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """
        Retrieve stored artifact by dataset_id.
        Returns None if not found or expired.
        """
        file_path = self.storage_dir / f"{dataset_id}.json"
        if not file_path.exists():
            return None

        with self._lock:
            try:
                with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    record = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error reading artifact {dataset_id}: {e}")
                return None

        expires_at = record.get("expires_at", 0)
        if expires_at > 0 and time.time() > expires_at:
            logger.info(f"Artifact {dataset_id} expired, cleaning up.")
            self.delete(dataset_id)
            return None

        raw_data = record.get("data")
        if as_dataframe and isinstance(raw_data, dict) and raw_data.get("__type__") == "dataframe":
            record["data"] = self._deserialize_data(raw_data)
        elif as_dataframe and isinstance(raw_data, list):
            record["data"] = pd.DataFrame(raw_data)

        return record

    def delete(self, dataset_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete an artifact by dataset_id."""
        file_path = self.storage_dir / f"{dataset_id}.json"
        with self._lock:
            if file_path.exists():
                try:
                    file_path.unlink()
                    return True
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Failed to delete artifact {dataset_id}: {e}")
        return False

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        """Scan and delete all expired artifacts. Returns number of removed files."""
        now = time.time()
        removed = 0
        with self._lock:
            for item in self.storage_dir.glob("*.json"):
                try:
                    with open(item, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                        data = json.load(f)
                    expires_at = data.get("expires_at", 0)
                    if expires_at > 0 and now > expires_at:
                        item.unlink()
                        removed += 1
                except Exception:
                    continue
        if removed > 0:
            logger.info(f"Cleaned up {removed} expired artifacts.")
        return removed


# Singleton instance
_store_instance: ArtifactStore | None = None
_store_lock = threading.Lock()


def get_artifact_store(storage_dir: Path | str | None = None) -> ArtifactStore:
    """Get or initialize singleton ArtifactStore instance."""
    global _store_instance
    with _store_lock:
        if _store_instance is None:
            _store_instance = ArtifactStore(storage_dir)
        return _store_instance

is an endpoint used by unofficial F1 community tools (like **MultiViewer for F1**[2] and data analysis libraries like **FastF1**[3]) to fetch spatial track layout and geometry metadata for Formula 1 circuits[2].

### What Data Does It Return?
When queried with a valid F1 `circuit_key`[3] and a target `season` year[4], the JSON response typically provides detailed mapping information used to render track layouts, which includes:
* **Circuit Identifiers:** Names, official designations, and location information.
* **Track Geometry / Rotation:** Coordinates and scaling data to map the circuit properly on a 2D canvas.
* **Corner Information:** Metadata regarding the track’s corners (such as corner numbers, names/labels, and their precise coordinate placements along the track vector path).
* **Zones:** Pit lane layout references and DRS zone indicators[5].

### How to Use It in Code (e.g., Python)
If you are trying to query this endpoint programmatically to extract track geometries or corner details, you can do so using standard HTTP requests:

```python
import json
import urllib.request

# Example: Monza (circuit_key: 39) for the 2026 season
url = "https://api.multiviewer.app/api/v1/circuits/39/2026"

req = urllib.request.Request(
    url, 
    headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
)

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))
        print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error fetching circuit data: {e}")
```

*(Note: Because this is part of MultiViewer's internal/community-maintained API layer[2], structure details or availability for upcoming tracks can occasionally shift based on updates to upstream F1 timing data feeds.)*

class CircuitCornerEngine:
    """
    Universal Circuit Corner Engine providing:
    1. MultiViewer geometry coordinates with local disk cache.
    2. Nickname-first corner resolution to prevent '130R' from parsing as Turn 130.
    3. Dynamic alias learning saved to learned_aliases.json.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        nicknames_file: Path | str = NICKNAMES_PATH,
        learned_aliases_file: Path | str = LEARNED_ALIASES_PATH,
        cache_dir: Path | str = CIRCUIT_CACHE_DIR,
    ):
        self.nicknames_file = Path(nicknames_file)
        self.learned_aliases_file = Path(learned_aliases_file)
        self.cache_dir = Path(cache_dir)
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._nicknames: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self._learned_aliases: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._load_nickname_sources()

    def _load_nickname_sources(self) -> None:
        """Load curated and learned corner nicknames from disk."""
        if self.nicknames_file.exists():
            try:
                with open(self.nicknames_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self._nicknames = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error loading {self.nicknames_file}: {e}")
                self._nicknames = []

        if self.learned_aliases_file.exists():
            try:
                with open(self.learned_aliases_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self._learned_aliases = json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error loading {self.learned_aliases_file}: {e}")
                self._learned_aliases = {}
        else:
            self._learned_aliases = {}

    def get_circuit_info(self, circuit_identifier: str | int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """Resolve a circuit identifier (name, GP, key, slug) to canonical metadata."""
        if isinstance(circuit_identifier, int):
            for info in CIRCUIT_METADATA.values():
                if info["key"] == circuit_identifier:
                    return info
            return {"key": circuit_identifier, "slug": f"circuit_{circuit_identifier}", "name": f"Circuit {circuit_identifier}"}

        norm = str(circuit_identifier).lower().strip()
        # Direct lookup
        if norm in CIRCUIT_METADATA:
            return CIRCUIT_METADATA[norm]

        # Partial matching
        for k, info in CIRCUIT_METADATA.items():
            if k in norm or norm in k:
                return info

        return None

    def fetch_circuit_geometry(self, circuit_key: int, year: int = 2024) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """
        Fetch MultiViewer circuit geometry from disk cache or upstream API.
        """
        cache_file = self.cache_dir / f"{circuit_key}_{year}.json"
        if cache_file.exists():
            try:
                with open(cache_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    return json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Error reading circuit cache {cache_file}: {e}")

        url = f"https://api.multiviewer.app/api/v1/circuits/{circuit_key}/{year}"
        try:
            with httpx.Client(timeout=10.0) as client:
                resp = client.get(url, headers={"User-Agent": "PitWallAI/1.0"})
                if resp.status_code == 200:
                    data = resp.json()
                    with self._lock:
                        with open(cache_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                            json.dump(data, f)
                    return data
                logger.warning(f"MultiViewer API returned {resp.status_code} for circuit {circuit_key}/{year}")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Failed to fetch MultiViewer geometry for {circuit_key}/{year}: {e}")

        # Check fallback to previous year if current year not available
        if year != 2024:
            return self.fetch_circuit_geometry(circuit_key, year=2024)

        return None

    def get_corner_coordinates(self, circuit_key: int, turn_number: int, year: int = 2024) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        """Get precise track coordinates (x, y) for a turn from MultiViewer geometry."""
        geom = self.fetch_circuit_geometry(circuit_key, year)
        if not geom or "corners" not in geom:
            return None

        for corner in geom.get("corners", []):
            if corner.get("number") == turn_number:
                pos = corner.get("trackPosition") or {}
                return {
                    "x": pos.get("x"),
                    "y": pos.get("y"),
                    "angle": corner.get("angle"),
                    "length": corner.get("length"),
                }
        return None

    def resolve_corner(
        self,
        circuit_query: str | int,
        corner_query: str,
        year: int = 2024,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Resolve a corner query for a given circuit.
        GUARANTEE: Checks nicknames and learned aliases BEFORE numeric regexes
        so '130R' NEVER resolves to Turn 130!
        """
        circuit_info = self.get_circuit_info(circuit_query)
        circuit_slug = circuit_info["slug"] if circuit_info else str(circuit_query).lower()
        circuit_key = circuit_info["key"] if circuit_info else 0
        circuit_name = circuit_info["name"] if circuit_info else str(circuit_query)

        query_clean = corner_query.strip().lower()

        # Step 1: Check Learned Aliases first (web verified)
        alias_key = f"{circuit_slug}:{query_clean}"
        if alias_key in self._learned_aliases:
            learned = self._learned_aliases[alias_key]
            turn_number = learned["turn_number"]
            nickname = learned.get("nickname", corner_query)
            coords = self.get_corner_coordinates(circuit_key, turn_number, year)
            return {
                "resolved": True,
                "circuit_key": circuit_key,
                "circuit_slug": circuit_slug,
                "circuit_name": circuit_name,
                "turn_number": turn_number,
                "nickname": nickname,
                "coordinates": coords,
                "distance_m": learned.get("distance_m", 0.0),
                "source": "learned_aliases",
            }

        # Step 2: Check Curated Nicknames (BEFORE any digit/turn regex)
        # First exact or word-boundary match
        matched_entry = None
        for entry in self._nicknames:
            if entry["circuit_key"] == circuit_slug:
                entry_nick = entry["nickname"].strip().lower()
                # Exact match or normalized match (e.g., '130r' == '130r', 'copse' in 'copse corner')
                if query_clean == entry_nick:
                    matched_entry = entry
                    break
                # Handle punctuation and partial phrasing: 'turn 130r' or 'copse corner'
                cleaned_entry_nick = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", entry_nick)
                cleaned_query = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", query_clean)
                if cleaned_entry_nick and cleaned_entry_nick == cleaned_query:
                    matched_entry = entry
                    break
                if entry_nick in query_clean and len(entry_nick) >= 4:
                    matched_entry = entry
                    break

        if matched_entry:
            turn_number = matched_entry["turn_number"]
            nickname = matched_entry["nickname"]
            distance_m = matched_entry.get("distance_m", 0.0)
            coords = self.get_corner_coordinates(circuit_key, turn_number, year)
            return {
                "resolved": True,
                "circuit_key": circuit_key,
                "circuit_slug": circuit_slug,
                "circuit_name": circuit_name,
                "turn_number": turn_number,
                "nickname": nickname,
                "coordinates": coords,
                "distance_m": distance_m,
                "source": "curated_nicknames",
            }

        # Step 3: Only if no nickname matched, check for explicit Turn numbers
        turn_match = re.search(r"(?:turn|corner|curva|t)\s*(\d+)", query_clean)
        if not turn_match:
            # Standalone number: "1", "4", "15" (do NOT match "130r" because of the trailing 'r')
            turn_match = re.search(r"^\s*(\d+)\s*$", query_clean)

        if turn_match:
            turn_number = int(turn_match.group(1))
            coords = self.get_corner_coordinates(circuit_key, turn_number, year)
            return {
                "resolved": True,
                "circuit_key": circuit_key,
                "circuit_slug": circuit_slug,
                "circuit_name": circuit_name,
                "turn_number": turn_number,
                "nickname": f"Turn {turn_number}",
                "coordinates": coords,
                "distance_m": 0.0,
                "source": "numeric_turn",
            }

        # Step 4: Corner is unknown
        return {
            "resolved": False,
            "unknown_corner": True,
            "query": corner_query,
            "circuit": circuit_name,
            "circuit_slug": circuit_slug,
            "circuit_key": circuit_key,
            "hint": f"Unknown corner '{corner_query}' at {circuit_name}. Please specify a valid corner nickname or Turn number.",
        }

    def learn_alias(
        self,
        circuit_slug: str,
        nickname: str,
        turn_number: int,
        distance_m: float = 0.0,
        source: str = "web_verified",
    ) -> None:
        """Persist a new discovered corner alias to learned_aliases.json."""
        alias_key = f"{circuit_slug.lower()}:{nickname.strip().lower()}"
        with self._lock:
            self._learned_aliases[alias_key] = {
                "circuit_slug": circuit_slug.lower(),
                "nickname": nickname.strip(),
                "turn_number": turn_number,
                "distance_m": distance_m,
                "source": source,
            }
            try:
                with open(self.learned_aliases_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    json.dump(self._learned_aliases, f, indent=2)
                logger.info(f"Learned alias saved: {alias_key} -> Turn {turn_number}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to persist learned alias {alias_key}: {e}")


# Singleton instance
_engine_instance: CircuitCornerEngine | None = None
_engine_lock = threading.Lock()


def get_circuit_corner_engine() -> CircuitCornerEngine:
    """Get or initialize singleton CircuitCornerEngine."""
    global _engine_instance
    with _engine_lock:
        if _engine_instance is None:
            _engine_instance = CircuitCornerEngine()
        return _engine_instance

"""
Historical SQL Specialist Agent for PitWall AI (A2A).
Executes read-only DuckDB queries with alias resolution and 1x zero-row retry,
storing full result tables in the shared ArtifactStore and returning compact summaries.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from google.adk.agents.llm_agent import LlmAgent
from a2a.types import AgentCard, AgentSkill, AgentCapabilities

from backend.app.a2a.artifact_store import get_artifact_store
from backend.app.data.duckdb_manager import get_duckdb_manager, validate_sql
from backend.app.agent.tools.historical_sql import _attempt_zero_row_correction

logger = logging.getLogger("pitwall.a2a.historical")


class HistoricalSQLAgent:
    """Specialist agent for DuckDB historical analytics (1950–2024+)."""

    def __init__(self, name: str = "historical_agent"):
        self.name = name
        self.db = get_duckdb_manager()
        self.artifact_store = get_artifact_store()
        self.adk_agent = self._build_adk_agent()

    def _build_adk_agent(self) -> LlmAgent:
        """Create ADK LlmAgent wrapper."""
        return LlmAgent(
            name=self.name,
            model="gemini-2.0-flash",
            instruction=(
                "You are the PitWall AI Historical Race Engineer. Query DuckDB historical views "
                "(v_race_results, v_qualifying, v_pit_stops, v_driver_standings, v_constructor_standings) "
                "for Formula 1 statistics from 1950 to 2024+. Never hallucinate statistics."
            ),
            tools=[self.execute_sql],
        )

    def execute_sql(self, sql: str, chart_title: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute a DuckDB SQL query, applying alias self-correction on zero-rows,
        storing the result in ArtifactStore, and returning compact summary with dataset_id.
        """
        t_start = time.perf_counter()
        clean_sql = sql.strip().rstrip(";")

        try:
            validate_sql(clean_sql)
            result = self.db.execute_query(clean_sql)
            executed_sql = clean_sql

            # 1x Zero-row retry with alias self-correction
            if result.get("row_count", 0) == 0:
                corrected = _attempt_zero_row_correction(clean_sql)
                if corrected and corrected != clean_sql:
                    try:
                        validate_sql(corrected)
                        corrected_res = self.db.execute_query(corrected)
                        if corrected_res.get("row_count", 0) > 0:
                            result = corrected_res
                            executed_sql = corrected
                            logger.info(f"Zero-row self-correction succeeded: {corrected}")
                    except Exception as err:
                        logger.warning(f"Zero-row correction failed: {err}")

            exec_time = round((time.perf_counter() - t_start) * 1000, 2)
            row_count = result.get("row_count", 0)
            data_rows = result.get("data", [])
            columns = result.get("columns", [])

            # Store the full result set in ArtifactStore
            dataset_metadata = {
                "domain": "historical_sql",
                "sql": executed_sql,
                "columns": columns,
                "row_count": row_count,
                "chart_title": chart_title,
            }
            dataset_id = self.artifact_store.put(
                data=data_rows,
                metadata=dataset_metadata,
                ttl_seconds=3600,
            )

            # Compact summary string for A2A message exchange
            summary = (
                f"Retrieved {row_count} rows across columns {columns} in {exec_time}ms. "
                f"Dataset stored under dataset_id='{dataset_id}'."
            )

            trace_payload = {
                "data_domain": "historical_sql",
                "sql": executed_sql,
                "row_count": row_count,
                "execution_time_ms": exec_time,
                "dataset_id": dataset_id,
            }

            return {
                "success": True,
                "domain": "historical_sql",
                "dataset_id": dataset_id,
                "row_count": row_count,
                "columns": columns,
                "summary": summary,
                "sample_rows": data_rows[:10],
                "trace": trace_payload,
                "error": None,
            }

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"HistoricalSQLAgent error on query: {sql}. Reason: {e}")
            return {
                "success": False,
                "domain": "historical_sql",
                "dataset_id": None,
                "row_count": 0,
                "columns": [],
                "summary": f"Query execution failed: {e}",
                "sample_rows": [],
                "trace": {
                    "data_domain": "historical_sql",
                    "sql": clean_sql,
                    "error": str(e),
                },
                "error": str(e),
            }

    def query(self, sql_or_query: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convenience query method for direct agent invocation."""
        if sql_or_query.strip().lower().startswith(("select", "with")):
            return self.execute_sql(sql_or_query)
        # Default query for tests or direct execution if standard SQL
        return self.execute_sql(sql_or_query)

    @classmethod
    def get_agent_card(cls, base_url: str = "http://localhost:8000/a2a/historical") -> AgentCard:
        """Construct standard A2A AgentCard for HistoricalSQLAgent."""
        return AgentCard(
            name="historical_agent",
            description="Formula 1 Historical Statistics Agent (1950-2024+) powered by DuckDB SQL curated views.",
            version="1.0.0",
            capabilities={"streaming": False},
            default_input_modes=["text"],
            default_output_modes=["text"],
            skills=[
                AgentSkill(
                    id="execute_sql",
                    name="execute_sql",
                    description="Executes a read-only DuckDB SQL query against historical F1 views (v_race_results, v_qualifying, v_pit_stops, v_driver_standings).",
                    parameters={
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "sql": {"type": "string", "description": "The SQL query to execute."},
                            "chart_title": {"type": "string", "description": "Optional title for chart visualization."},
                        },
                        "required": ["sql"],
                    },
                )
            ],
        )


_historical_agent_instance: Optional[HistoricalSQLAgent] = None


def get_historical_agent() -> HistoricalSQLAgent:
    """Get singleton HistoricalSQLAgent."""
    global _historical_agent_instance
    if _historical_agent_instance is None:
        _historical_agent_instance = HistoricalSQLAgent()
    return _historical_agent_instance

"""
Telemetry Specialist Agent for PitWall AI (A2A).
Provides:
- Corner telemetry comparison using CircuitCornerEngine (resolves '130R' to Turn 15, returns unknown_corner hint if unknown)
- Full-lap telemetry overlay
- Tyre stint degradation analytics
- Strict 2023+ OpenF1 era boundary enforcement
- Large series/dataframes stored in ArtifactStore; compact metrics + dataset_id returned.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import numpy as np
from google.adk.agents.llm_agent import LlmAgent
from a2a.types import AgentCard, AgentSkill

from backend.app.a2a.artifact_store import get_artifact_store
from backend.app.data.circuit_corners import get_circuit_corner_engine
from backend.app.data.openf1_client import get_openf1_client
from backend.app.agent.tools.corner_compare import (
    compare_corners as base_compare_corners,
    compute_corner_metrics,
)
from backend.app.agent.tools.telemetry import (
    compare_full_lap_telemetry as base_compare_full_lap,
)
from backend.app.agent.tools.strategy import (
    analyze_tyre_stints as base_analyze_stints,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("pitwall.a2a.telemetry")


class TelemetryAgent:
    """Specialist agent for OpenF1 car sensor telemetry & strategy (2023–present)."""

    def __init__(self, name: str = "telemetry_agent"):
        self.name = name
        self.artifact_store = get_artifact_store()
        self.corner_engine = get_circuit_corner_engine()
        self.openf1_client = get_openf1_client()
        self.adk_agent = self._build_adk_agent()

    def _build_adk_agent(self) -> LlmAgent:
        """Create ADK LlmAgent wrapper."""
        return LlmAgent(
            name=self.name,
            model="gemini-2.0-flash",
            instruction=(
                "You are the PitWall AI Telemetry & Strategy Engineer. Analyze high-frequency car sensor "
                "telemetry (speed, throttle, brake, gear, delta) and tyre stint degradation for 2023-present "
                "Formula 1 sessions using OpenF1. Never hallucinate sensor readings."
            ),
            tools=[self.compare_corners, self.compare_full_lap, self.analyze_tyre_stints],
        )

    def _check_era_boundary(self, year: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Enforce strict 2023+ OpenF1 era boundary."""
        if year < 2023:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "era_boundary": True,
                "year": year,
                "message": (
                    f"Car sensor telemetry is available for the 2023–present seasons via OpenF1. "
                    f"For {year}, only lap-by-lap pace and finishing statistics are available via historical DuckDB data."
                ),
                "suggestion": "query_historical_f1",
            }
        return None

    def compare_corners(
        self,
        year: int,
        grand_prix: str,
        session_type: str,
        driver_1: str,
        driver_2: str,
        corner: str,
        lap_number_1: Optional[int] = None,
        lap_number_2: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Compare corner telemetry between two drivers.
        Uses CircuitCornerEngine for nickname-first resolution (e.g. Suzuka 130R -> Turn 15).
        Returns structured unknown_corner hint if corner nickname is unrecognized.
        Stores heavy interpolated series in ArtifactStore and returns compact metrics + dataset_id.
        """
        # 1. Era boundary check
        era_check = self._check_era_boundary(year)
        if era_check:
            return era_check

        # 2. Corner Nickname Resolution via CircuitCornerEngine
        corner_res = self.corner_engine.resolve_corner(
            circuit_query=grand_prix,
            corner_query=corner,
            year=year,
        )

        if not corner_res.get("resolved"):
            logger.info(f"Unknown corner query '{corner}' at {grand_prix}.")
            return {
                "success": False,
                "unknown_corner": True,
                "corner_query": corner,
                "grand_prix": grand_prix,
                "year": year,
                "hint": corner_res.get("hint", f"Unknown corner '{corner}' at {grand_prix}."),
            }

        # 3. Execute base corner comparison
        turn_num = corner_res.get("turn_number")
        corner_nick = corner_res.get("nickname")

        base_res = base_compare_corners(
            year=year,
            grand_prix=grand_prix,
            session_type=session_type,
            driver_1=driver_1,
            driver_2=driver_2,
            corner=str(turn_num) if turn_num else corner,
            lap_number_1=lap_number_1,
            lap_number_2=lap_number_2,
        )

        if not base_res.get("success"):
            return base_res

        # 4. Store raw telemetry arrays in ArtifactStore
        dataset_metadata = {
            "domain": "corner_telemetry",
            "year": year,
            "grand_prix": grand_prix,
            "session_type": session_type,
            "drivers": [driver_1, driver_2],
            "turn_number": turn_num,
            "corner_nickname": corner_nick,
            "metrics": base_res.get("metrics"),
        }
        dataset_id = self.artifact_store.put(
            data={
                "metrics": base_res.get("metrics"),
                "chart_spec": base_res.get("chart", {}).get("spec"),
                "minimap_spec": base_res.get("minimap", {}).get("spec"),
                "metadata": base_res.get("chart", {}).get("metadata"),
            },
            metadata=dataset_metadata,
            ttl_seconds=3600,
        )

        # 5. Return compact metrics + dataset_id
        return {
            "success": True,
            "domain": "corner_telemetry",
            "dataset_id": dataset_id,
            "metrics": base_res.get("metrics"),
            "corner_info": corner_res,
            "summary": (
                f"Corner comparison for {driver_1} vs {driver_2} at {grand_prix} {corner_nick} (Turn {turn_num}) "
                f"computed successfully. Apex speeds: {base_res.get('metrics', {}).get('apex_min_speed', {})}. "
                f"Stored in artifact '{dataset_id}'."
            ),
            "trace": base_res.get("trace", {}),
        }

    def compare_full_lap(
        self,
        year: int,
        grand_prix: str,
        session_type: str,
        driver_1: str,
        driver_2: str,
        lap_number_1: Optional[int] = None,
        lap_number_2: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Compare full-lap telemetry between two drivers."""
        era_check = self._check_era_boundary(year)
        if era_check:
            return era_check

        base_res = base_compare_full_lap(
            year=year,
            grand_prix=grand_prix,
            session_type=session_type,
            driver_1=driver_1,
            driver_2=driver_2,
            lap_number_1=lap_number_1,
            lap_number_2=lap_number_2,
        )

        if not base_res.get("success"):
            return base_res

        dataset_metadata = {
            "domain": "full_lap_telemetry",
            "year": year,
            "grand_prix": grand_prix,
            "session_type": session_type,
            "drivers": [driver_1, driver_2],
            "metrics": base_res.get("metrics"),
        }
        dataset_id = self.artifact_store.put(
            data={
                "metrics": base_res.get("metrics"),
                "chart_spec": base_res.get("chart", {}).get("spec"),
                "metadata": base_res.get("chart", {}).get("metadata"),
            },
            metadata=dataset_metadata,
            ttl_seconds=3600,
        )

        return {
            "success": True,
            "domain": "full_lap_telemetry",
            "dataset_id": dataset_id,
            "metrics": base_res.get("metrics"),
            "summary": (
                f"Full lap telemetry overlay for {driver_1} vs {driver_2} at {grand_prix} {year} "
                f"computed successfully. Lap deltas: {base_res.get('metrics', {}).get('lap_time_delta_s', 0)}s. "
                f"Stored in artifact '{dataset_id}'."
            ),
            "trace": base_res.get("trace", {}),
        }

    def analyze_tyre_stints(
        self,
        year: int,
        grand_prix: str,
        session_type: str = "Race",
        drivers: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze tyre stint pace degradation."""
        era_check = self._check_era_boundary(year)
        if era_check:
            return era_check

        base_res = base_analyze_stints(
            year=year,
            grand_prix=grand_prix,
            session_type=session_type,
            drivers=drivers,
        )

        if not base_res.get("success"):
            return base_res

        dataset_metadata = {
            "domain": "tyre_degradation",
            "year": year,
            "grand_prix": grand_prix,
            "session_type": session_type,
            "drivers": drivers or [],
        }
        dataset_id = self.artifact_store.put(
            data={
                "stints": base_res.get("stints"),
                "clean_laps": base_res.get("clean_laps"),
                "outlier_laps": base_res.get("outlier_laps"),
                "chart_spec": base_res.get("chart", {}).get("spec"),
                "metadata": base_res.get("chart", {}).get("metadata"),
            },
            metadata=dataset_metadata,
            ttl_seconds=3600,
        )

        return {
            "success": True,
            "domain": "tyre_degradation",
            "dataset_id": dataset_id,
            "stints": base_res.get("stints"),
            "summary": (
                f"Tyre stint degradation analysis at {grand_prix} {year} completed. "
                f"Stored in artifact '{dataset_id}'."
            ),
            "trace": base_res.get("trace", {}),
        }

    @classmethod
    def get_agent_card(cls, base_url: str = "http://localhost:8000/a2a/telemetry") -> AgentCard:
        """Construct standard A2A AgentCard for TelemetryAgent."""
        return AgentCard(
            name="telemetry_agent",
            description="Formula 1 Car Telemetry & Tyre Strategy Agent (2023–present) powered by OpenF1 and CircuitCornerEngine.",
            version="1.0.0",
            capabilities={"streaming": False},
            default_input_modes=["text"],
            default_output_modes=["text"],
            skills=[
                AgentSkill(
                    id="compare_corners",
                    name="compare_corners",
                    description="Compares high-frequency telemetry across a corner (braking point, apex speed, throttle pickup).",
                    parameters={
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "year": {"type": "integer"},
                            "grand_prix": {"type": "string"},
                            "session_type": {"type": "string"},
                            "driver_1": {"type": "string"},
                            "driver_2": {"type": "string"},
                            "corner": {"type": "string"},
                        },
                        "required": ["year", "grand_prix", "session_type", "driver_1", "driver_2", "corner"],
                    },
                ),
                AgentSkill(
                    id="compare_full_lap",
                    name="compare_full_lap",
                    description="Compares full-lap telemetry overlay and sector times between two drivers.",
                    parameters={
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "year": {"type": "integer"},
                            "grand_prix": {"type": "string"},
                            "session_type": {"type": "string"},
                            "driver_1": {"type": "string"},
                            "driver_2": {"type": "string"},
                        },
                        "required": ["year", "grand_prix", "session_type", "driver_1", "driver_2"],
                    },
                ),
            ],
        )


_telemetry_agent_instance: Optional[TelemetryAgent] = None


def get_telemetry_agent() -> TelemetryAgent:
    """Get singleton TelemetryAgent."""
    global _telemetry_agent_instance
    if _telemetry_agent_instance is None:
        _telemetry_agent_instance = TelemetryAgent()
    return _telemetry_agent_instance

"""
Research Specialist Agent for PitWall AI (A2A).
Handles:
- Off-dataset Formula 1 questions (regulations, steward decisions, driver quotes, weather, technical updates)
- Grounded web search via Google Gemini google_search grounding (when GOOGLE_API_KEY available)
- Graceful offline fallback in local Ollama mode
- Web verification of unknown corner nicknames -> turn numbers, persisting to learned_aliases.json
- Storing research sources & cards in ArtifactStore with dataset_id
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import re
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from google.adk.agents.llm_agent import LlmAgent
from a2a.types import AgentCard, AgentSkill

from backend.app.config import settings
from backend.app.a2a.artifact_store import get_artifact_store
from backend.app.data.circuit_corners import get_circuit_corner_engine

logger = logging.getLogger("pitwall.a2a.research")


class ResearchAgent:
    """Specialist agent for web intelligence and corner nickname discovery."""

    def __init__(self, name: str = "research_agent"):
        self.name = name
        self.artifact_store = get_artifact_store()
        self.corner_engine = get_circuit_corner_engine()
        self.has_gemini = bool(settings.GOOGLE_API_KEY)
        self.adk_agent = self._build_adk_agent()

    def _build_adk_agent(self) -> LlmAgent:
        """Create ADK LlmAgent wrapper."""
        tools = [self.research_topic, self.resolve_and_learn_corner]
        return LlmAgent(
            name=self.name,
            model="gemini-2.0-flash" if self.has_gemini else "ollama_chat/qwen3.5:4b",
            instruction=(
                "You are the PitWall AI Research Engineer. Search live web sources for off-dataset F1 inquiries "
                "such as regulations, driver quotes, weather forecasts, technical upgrades, and track corner designations. "
                "Always provide source citations."
            ),
            tools=tools,
        )

    def research_topic(self, query: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Execute web research on an F1 topic.
        If Gemini grounding is available, runs grounded search; otherwise uses structured offline fallback.
        """
        t_start = time.perf_counter()

        sources: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
        findings: List[str] = []
        summary = ""

        if not self.has_gemini:
            # Offline / local Ollama mode fallback
            summary = (
                f"Web search is unavailable in offline/local LLM mode. "
                f"General domain context for '{query}': Formula 1 regulations, historical statistics, and race data "
                f"are accessible via historical DuckDB views and cached telemetry."
            )
            findings = [
                "Live web grounding requires active GOOGLE_API_KEY.",
                "Offline dataset contains all official F1 race results (1950–2024+) and car telemetry (2023+).",
            ]
            sources = [{"title": "PitWall AI Offline Knowledge", "uri": "local://pitwall-db"}]
        else:
            try:
                from google import genai
                from google.genai import types

                client = genai.Client(api_key=settings.GOOGLE_API_KEY)
                prompt = (
                    f"You are a Formula 1 research specialist. Answer this question concisely with exact facts: {query}\n"
                    f"Cite specific race events, driver quotes, regulations, or dates where applicable."
                )

                # Generate content with google search grounding tool
                response = client.models.generate_content(
                    model="gemini-2.0-flash",
                    contents=prompt,
                    config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
                        tools=[types.Tool(google_search=types.GoogleSearch())],
                    ),
                )

                summary = response.text or "No text generated."

                # Extract grounding metadata sources if returned
                if response.candidates and response.candidates[0].grounding_metadata:
                    gm = response.candidates[0].grounding_metadata
                    if gm.grounding_chunks:
                        for chunk in gm.grounding_chunks:
                            if chunk.web:
                                sources.append({
                                    "title": chunk.web.title or "F1 Reference",
                                    "uri": chunk.web.uri or "",
                                })

                findings = [line.strip() for line in summary.split("\n") if line.strip().startswith(("-", "•", "*", "1.", "2."))]
                if not findings:
                    findings = [summary[:200] + "..."]

            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Gemini grounding search error: {e}")
                summary = f"Research inquiry processed with offline fallback: {query}"
                findings = [f"Web search unavailable: {str(e)}"]
                sources = [{"title": "Formula 1 Regulations & Historical Archive", "uri": "https://www.formula1.com"}]

        exec_time = round((time.perf_counter() - t_start) * 1000, 2)

        # Store research payload in ArtifactStore
        dataset_metadata = {
            "domain": "research",
            "query": query,
            "sources_count": len(sources),
        }
        dataset_id = self.artifact_store.put(
            data={
                "query": query,
                "summary": summary,
                "findings": findings,
                "sources": sources,
            },
            metadata=dataset_metadata,
            ttl_seconds=3600,
        )

        web_card = {
            "topic": query,
            "summary": summary,
            "key_findings": findings,
            "sources": sources,
            "confidence": 0.95 if self.has_gemini else 0.70,
        }

        return {
            "success": True,
            "domain": "research",
            "dataset_id": dataset_id,
            "summary": summary,
            "web_card": web_card,
            "sources": sources,
            "execution_time_ms": exec_time,
            "trace": {
                "data_domain": "research",
                "query": query,
                "sources_count": len(sources),
                "grounding_provider": "gemini_google_search" if self.has_gemini else "offline_knowledge",
            },
        }

    def resolve_and_learn_corner(self, circuit: str, corner_query: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Research an unknown corner nickname, determine its official turn number,
        verify against MultiViewer geometry, and save to learned_aliases.json.
        """
        circuit_info = self.corner_engine.get_circuit_info(circuit)
        circuit_slug = circuit_info["slug"] if circuit_info else circuit.lower().replace(" ", "_")
        circuit_key = circuit_info["key"] if circuit_info else 0

        # Ask targeted query
        search_prompt = (
            f"What official Turn number is the corner called '{corner_query}' at the Formula 1 circuit "
            f"'{circuit_info['name'] if circuit_info else circuit}'? Reply with just the number or 'Turn X'."
        )
        research_res = self.research_topic(search_prompt)
        text = research_res.get("summary", "")

        turn_match = re.search(r"(?:turn|corner|curva|t)\s*(\d+)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if not turn_match:
            turn_match = re.search(r"\b(\d{1,2})\b", text)

        if turn_match:
            candidate_turn = int(turn_match.group(1))
            # Verify candidate turn against MultiViewer circuit geometry
            coords = self.corner_engine.get_corner_coordinates(circuit_key, candidate_turn)
            if coords:
                # Successfully verified! Learn alias
                self.corner_engine.learn_alias(
                    circuit_slug=circuit_slug,
                    nickname=corner_query,
                    turn_number=candidate_turn,
                    distance_m=float(coords.get("length", 0.0) / 10.0) if coords.get("length") else 0.0,
                    source="web_verified",
                )
                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "verified": True,
                    "circuit": circuit_slug,
                    "corner_nickname": corner_query,
                    "turn_number": candidate_turn,
                    "coordinates": coords,
                    "message": f"Successfully verified '{corner_query}' as Turn {candidate_turn} at {circuit_slug} and updated learned aliases.",
                }

        return {
            "success": False,
            "verified": False,
            "circuit": circuit_slug,
            "corner_nickname": corner_query,
            "message": f"Could not definitively verify Turn number for corner '{corner_query}' at {circuit_slug}.",
        }

args.Content:
"""
Presentation & Visualization Specialist Agent for PitWall AI (A2A).
Consumes dataset_id from ArtifactStore and renders deterministic, WCAG AA compliant
dark HUD (#0B0F17) Plotly charts or Web Intelligence Cards conforming to the Pydantic VizSpec schema.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from google.adk.agents.llm_agent import LlmAgent
from a2a.types import AgentCard, AgentSkill

from backend.app.a2a.artifact_store import get_artifact_store
from backend.app.charts.historical_charts import auto_build_historical_chart
from backend.app.charts.plotly_theme import HUD_BG_COLOR

logger = logging.getLogger("pitwall.a2a.presentation")


class VizSpec(BaseModel):
    """Pydantic model representing a rendered visualization specification."""
    chart_type: str = Field(description="Type: 'plotly_figure', 'web_intelligence_card', or 'table'")
    figure: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(default=None, description="Plotly JSON payload conforming to dark HUD standard")
    web_card: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(default=None, description="Structured web research card")
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Standardized telemetry/historical metadata")
    summary: str = Field(default="", description="Engineer takeaway or visual summary")


class PresentationAgent:
    """Specialist agent for turning data artifacts into dark HUD visuals."""

    def __init__(self, name: str = "presentation_agent"):
        self.name = name
        self.artifact_store = get_artifact_store()
        self.adk_agent = self._build_adk_agent()

    def _build_adk_agent(self) -> LlmAgent:
        """Create ADK LlmAgent wrapper."""
        return LlmAgent(
            name=self.name,
            model="gemini-2.0-flash",
            instruction=(
                "You are the PitWall AI Presentation & Graphics Specialist. Transform dataset artifacts into "
                "dark HUD (#0B0F17) Plotly visualizations and intelligence cards. Ensure strict WCAG AA contrast."
            ),
            tools=[self.render_visualization],
        )

    def render_visualization(
        self,
        dataset_id: str,
        user_query: str = "",
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        summary: str = "",
        display_preferences: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Retrieve data from ArtifactStore[dataset_id] and produce a deterministic VizSpec.
        """
        record = self.artifact_store.get(dataset_id)
        if not record:
            logger.warning(f"Artifact not found for dataset_id='{dataset_id}'.")
            spec = VizSpec(
                chart_type="table",
                figure=None,
                web_card=None,
                metadata={"domain": domain or "unknown", "error": "Artifact expired or not found"},
                summary=f"No stored artifact found for id '{dataset_id}'.",
            )
            return spec.model_dump()

        data = record.get("data")
        artifact_meta = record.get("metadata", {})
        active_domain = domain or artifact_meta.get("domain", "historical_sql")

        # 1. Historical SQL Domain
        if active_domain == "historical_sql":
            sql = artifact_meta.get("sql", "")
            columns = artifact_meta.get("columns", [])
            data_rows = data if isinstance(data, list) else []

            chart_result = auto_build_historical_chart(
                sql=sql,
                columns=columns,
                data=data_rows,
                title_hint=artifact_meta.get("chart_title") or user_query,
            )

            fig_payload = None
            metadata = {
                "domain": "historical_sql",
                "sql": sql,
                "row_count": len(data_rows),
                "mode_label": "Historical Statistics",
            }

            if chart_result and "figure" in chart_result:
                fig_payload = chart_result["figure"]
                metadata = chart_result.get("metadata", metadata)

            spec = VizSpec(
                chart_type="plotly_figure" if fig_payload else "table",
                figure=fig_payload,
                metadata=metadata,
                summary=summary or f"Historical data plotted with {len(data_rows)} rows.",
            )
            return spec.model_dump()

        # 2. Corner Telemetry Domain
        elif active_domain == "corner_telemetry":
            chart_spec = data.get("chart_spec") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
            meta = (
                data.get("metadata")
                if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("metadata")
                else artifact_meta
            )

            spec = VizSpec(
                chart_type="plotly_figure",
                figure=chart_spec,
                metadata=meta,
                summary=summary or "Corner telemetry comparison rendered.",
            )
            return spec.model_dump()

        # 3. Full-Lap Telemetry Domain
        elif active_domain == "full_lap_telemetry":
            chart_spec = data.get("chart_spec") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
            meta = (
                data.get("metadata")
                if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("metadata")
                else artifact_meta
            )

            spec = VizSpec(
                chart_type="plotly_figure",
                figure=chart_spec,
                metadata=meta,
                summary=summary or "Full lap telemetry overlay rendered.",
            )
            return spec.model_dump()

        # 4. Tyre Stint Degradation Domain
        elif active_domain == "tyre_degradation":
            chart_spec = data.get("chart_spec") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
            meta = (
                data.get("metadata")
                if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("metadata")
                else artifact_meta
            )

            spec = VizSpec(
                chart_type="plotly_figure",
                figure=chart_spec,
                metadata=meta,
                summary=summary or "Tyre pace degradation scatter and regression rendered.",
            )
            return spec.model_dump()

        # 5. Research / Web Intelligence Domain
        elif active_domain == "research":
            web_card = {
                "topic": artifact_meta.get("query", user_query),
                "summary": data.get("summary", summary) if isinstance(data, dict) else summary,
                "key_findings": data.get("findings", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else [],
                "sources": data.get("sources", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else [],
                "confidence": 0.95,
            }

            spec = VizSpec(
                chart_type="web_intelligence_card",
                web_card=web_card,
                metadata={
                    "domain": "research",
                    "mode_label": "Web Intelligence",
                    "sources_count": len(web_card["sources"]),
                },
                summary=summary or web_card["summary"],
            )
            return spec.model_dump()

        # Default fallback
        spec = VizSpec(
            chart_type="table",
            metadata={"domain": active_domain},
            summary=summary or "Raw data artifact presented.",
        )
        return spec.model_dump()

    @classmethod
    def get_agent_card(cls, base_url: str = "http://localhost:8000/a2a/viz") -> AgentCard:
        """Construct standard A2A AgentCard for PresentationAgent."""
        return AgentCard(
            name="presentation_agent",
            description="Formula 1 Dark HUD Data Visualization Agent rendering Plotly JSON figures and Web Intelligence cards.",
            version="1.0.0",
            capabilities={"streaming": False},
            default_input_modes=["text"],
            default_output_modes=["text"],
            skills=[
                AgentSkill(
                    id="render_visualization",
                    name="render_visualization",
                    description="Renders a stored dataset_id into a dark HUD Plotly chart or web intelligence card.",
                    parameters={
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "dataset_id": {"type": "string"},
                            "domain": {"type": "string"},
                            "user_query": {"type": "string"},
                        },
                        "required": ["dataset_id"],
                    },
                )
            ],
        )


_presentation_agent_instance: Optional[PresentationAgent] = None


def get_presentation_agent() -> PresentationAgent:
    """Get singleton PresentationAgent."""
    global _presentation_agent_instance
    if _presentation_agent_instance is None:
        _presentation_agent_instance = PresentationAgent()
    return _presentation_agent_instance

"""
A2A (Agent-to-Agent) Registry and ASGI Router for PitWall AI.
Mounts AgentCard discovery endpoints (/.well-known/agent-card.json) and JSON-RPC / direct
execution routes for the 4 specialist agents:
- /a2a/historical
- /a2a/telemetry
- /a2a/research
- /a2a/viz
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request, Response
from google.protobuf.json_format import MessageToDict
from pydantic import BaseModel

from backend.app.a2a.agents.historical_agent import (
    HistoricalSQLAgent,
    get_historical_agent,
)
from backend.app.a2a.agents.telemetry_agent import (
    TelemetryAgent,
    get_telemetry_agent,
)
from backend.app.a2a.agents.research_agent import (
    ResearchAgent,
    get_research_agent,
)
from backend.app.a2a.agents.presentation_agent import (
    PresentationAgent,
    get_presentation_agent,
)

logger = logging.getLogger("pitwall.a2a.registry")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/a2a", tags=["A2A Agents"])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Request Models
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class HistoricalQueryRequest(BaseModel):
    sql: str
    chart_title: Optional[str] = None


class CornerCompareRequest(BaseModel):
    year: int
    grand_prix: str
    session_type: str = "Qualifying"
    driver_1: str
    driver_2: str
    corner: str
    lap_number_1: Optional[int] = None
    lap_number_2: Optional[int] = None


class FullLapCompareRequest(BaseModel):
    year: int
    grand_prix: str
    session_type: str = "Qualifying"
    driver_1: str
    driver_2: str
    lap_number_1: Optional[int] = None
    lap_number_2: Optional[int] = None


class TyreStintsRequest(BaseModel):
    year: int
    grand_prix: str
    session_type: str = "Race"
    drivers: Optional[List[str]] = None


class ResearchQueryRequest(BaseModel):
    query: str


class VizRenderRequest(BaseModel):
    dataset_id: str
    user_query: str = ""
    domain: Optional[str] = None
    summary: str = ""
    display_preferences: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: Proto AgentCard to Dict
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _card_to_json(card) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return MessageToDict(card, preserving_proto_field_name=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Historical Agent Endpoints (/a2a/historical)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/historical/.well-known/agent-card.json")
async def historical_agent_card():
    """Agent Card for HistoricalSQLAgent."""
    card = HistoricalSQLAgent.get_agent_card()
    return _card_to_json(card)


@router.post("/historical/query")
async def historical_query(req: HistoricalQueryRequest):
    """Direct query endpoint for HistoricalSQLAgent."""
    agent = get_historical_agent()
    result = agent.execute_sql(sql=req.sql, chart_title=req.chart_title)
    return result


@router.post("/historical")
async def historical_rpc(request: Request):
    """JSON-RPC / A2A generic execution endpoint for HistoricalSQLAgent."""
    body = await request.json()
    agent = get_historical_agent()

    # Handle standard JSON-RPC format or direct payload
    sql = body.get("params", {}).get("sql") or body.get("sql")
    if not sql:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing 'sql' in parameters")

    result = agent.execute_sql(sql=sql, chart_title=body.get("chart_title"))
    if "id" in body:
        return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "result": result, "id": body["id"]}
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Telemetry Agent Endpoints (/a2a/telemetry)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/telemetry/.well-known/agent-card.json")
async def telemetry_agent_card():
    """Agent Card for TelemetryAgent."""
    card = TelemetryAgent.get_agent_card()
    return _card_to_json(card)


@router.post("/telemetry/compare-corners")
async def telemetry_compare_corners(req: CornerCompareRequest):
    """Direct corner comparison endpoint for TelemetryAgent."""
    agent = get_telemetry_agent()
    return agent.compare_corners(
        year=req.year,
        grand_prix=req.grand_prix,
        session_type=req.session_type,
        driver_1=req.driver_1,
        driver_2=req.driver_2,
        corner=req.corner,
        lap_number_1=req.lap_number_1,
        lap_number_2=req.lap_number_2,
    )


@router.post("/telemetry/compare-lap")
async def telemetry_compare_lap(req: FullLapCompareRequest):
    """Direct full-lap overlay endpoint for TelemetryAgent."""
    agent = get_telemetry_agent()
    return agent.compare_full_lap(
        year=req.year,
        grand_prix=req.grand_prix,
        session_type=req.session_type,
        driver_1=req.driver_1,
        driver_2=req.driver_2,
        lap_number_1=req.lap_number_1,
        lap_number_2=req.lap_number_2,
    )


@router.post("/telemetry/tyre-stints")
async def telemetry_tyre_stints(req: TyreStintsRequest):
    """Direct tyre degradation endpoint for TelemetryAgent."""
    agent = get_telemetry_agent()
    return agent.analyze_tyre_stints(
        year=req.year,
        grand_prix=req.grand_prix,
        session_type=req.session_type,
        drivers=req.drivers,
    )


@router.post("/telemetry")
async def telemetry_rpc(request: Request):
    """JSON-RPC / A2A generic execution endpoint for TelemetryAgent."""
    body = await request.json()
    params = body.get("params", body)
    agent = get_telemetry_agent()

    skill = body.get("method") or params.get("skill") or "compare_corners"
    if skill == "compare_full_lap":
        result = agent.compare_full_lap(
            year=params.get("year", 2024),
            grand_prix=params.get("grand_prix", "Monza"),
            session_type=params.get("session_type", "Qualifying"),
            driver_1=params.get("driver_1", "LEC"),
            driver_2=params.get("driver_2", "PIA"),
        )
    elif skill == "analyze_tyre_stints":
        result = agent.analyze_tyre_stints(
            year=params.get("year", 2024),
            grand_prix=params.get("grand_prix", "Monza"),
            session_type=params.get("session_type", "Race"),
            drivers=params.get("drivers", ["LEC"]),
        )
    else:
        result = agent.compare_corners(
            year=params.get("year", 2024),
            grand_prix=params.get("grand_prix", "Silverstone"),
            session_type=params.get("session_type", "Qualifying"),
            driver_1=params.get("driver_1", "VER"),
            driver_2=params.get("driver_2", "NOR"),
            corner=params.get("corner", "Copse"),
        )

    if "id" in body:
        return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "result": result, "id": body["id"]}
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Research Agent Endpoints (/a2a/research)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/research/.well-known/agent-card.json")
async def research_agent_card():
    """Agent Card for ResearchAgent."""
    card = ResearchAgent.get_agent_card()
    return _card_to_json(card)


@router.post("/research/query")
async def research_query(req: ResearchQueryRequest):
    """Direct research query endpoint for ResearchAgent."""
    agent = get_research_agent()
    return agent.research_topic(req.query)


@router.post("/research")
async def research_rpc(request: Request):
    """JSON-RPC / A2A generic execution endpoint for ResearchAgent."""
    body = await request.json()
    params = body.get("params", body)
    agent = get_research_agent()

    query = params.get("query")
    if not query:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing 'query' parameter")

    result = agent.research_topic(query)
    if "id" in body:
        return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "result": result, "id": body["id"]}
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Presentation Agent Endpoints (/a2a/viz)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/viz/.well-known/agent-card.json")
async def presentation_agent_card():
    """Agent Card for PresentationAgent."""
    card = PresentationAgent.get_agent_card()
    return _card_to_json(card)


@router.post("/viz/render")
async def presentation_render(req: VizRenderRequest):
    """Direct visualization render endpoint for PresentationAgent."""
    agent = get_presentation_agent()
    return agent.render_visualization(
        dataset_id=req.dataset_id,
        user_query=req.user_query,
        domain=req.domain,
        summary=req.summary,
        display_preferences=req.display_preferences,
    )


@router.post("/viz")
async def presentation_rpc(request: Request):
    """JSON-RPC / A2A generic execution endpoint for PresentationAgent."""
    body = await request.json()
    params = body.get("params", body)
    agent = get_presentation_agent()

    dataset_id = params.get("dataset_id")
    if not dataset_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Missing 'dataset_id' parameter")

    result = agent.render_visualization(
        dataset_id=dataset_id,
        user_query=params.get("user_query", ""),
        domain=params.get("domain"),
        summary=params.get("summary", ""),
        display_preferences=params.get("display_preferences"),
    )
    if "id" in body:
        return {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "result": result, "id": body["id"]}
    return result

"""
Pytest suite for PitWall AI A2A Multi-Agent Architecture (Pass 1).
Validates:
1. All 4 /.well-known/agent-card.json endpoints return valid Agent Cards.
2. CircuitCornerEngine resolves Suzuka '130R' to Turn 15 (NOT Turn 130).
3. TelemetryAgent enforces 2023+ boundary and unknown corner handling.
4. HistoricalSQLAgent resolves Brazil 2021 (São Paulo GP) via alias self-correction + ArtifactStore.
5. PresentationAgent generates valid dark HUD Plotly figure payloads and web_intelligence_cards.
"""

import time
import pytest
from starlette.testclient import TestClient

from backend.app.main import app
from backend.app.a2a.artifact_store import get_artifact_store
from backend.app.data.circuit_corners import get_circuit_corner_engine
from backend.app.a2a.agents.historical_agent import get_historical_agent
from backend.app.a2a.agents.telemetry_agent import get_telemetry_agent
from backend.app.a2a.agents.research_agent import get_research_agent
from backend.app.a2a.agents.presentation_agent import get_presentation_agent


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def client():
    """Test client for FastAPI app."""
    return TestClient(app)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 1: Agent Card Endpoints
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_agent_cards_endpoints(client):
    """Verify all 4 specialist agent card endpoints return valid A2A AgentCard specs."""
    endpoints = [
        ("/a2a/historical/.well-known/agent-card.json", "historical_agent"),
        ("/a2a/telemetry/.well-known/agent-card.json", "telemetry_agent"),
        ("/a2a/research/.well-known/agent-card.json", "research_agent"),
        ("/a2a/viz/.well-known/agent-card.json", "presentation_agent"),
    ]

    for path, expected_name in endpoints:
        res = client.get(path)
        assert res.status_code == 200, f"Failed GET {path}: {res.text}"
        data = res.json()
        assert data.get("name") == expected_name, f"Expected {expected_name}, got {data.get('name')}"
        assert data.get("version") == "1.0.0"
        assert len(data.get("skills", [])) >= 1, f"No skills listed for {expected_name}"
        assert len(data.get("supported_interfaces", [])) >= 1, f"No interfaces listed for {expected_name}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 2: CircuitCornerEngine Suzuka 130R Nickname Disambiguation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_circuit_corner_engine_disambiguation():
    """
    Verify nickname matching runs BEFORE turn number regex so '130R' NEVER resolves to Turn 130.
    """
    engine = get_circuit_corner_engine()

    # Suzuka 130R -> Turn 15
    res_130r = engine.resolve_corner("suzuka", "130R")
    assert res_130r["resolved"] is True
    assert res_130r["turn_number"] == 15, "130R MUST resolve to Turn 15, never Turn 130!"
    assert res_130r["coordinates"] is not None
    assert "x" in res_130r["coordinates"] and "y" in res_130r["coordinates"]

    # Silverstone Copse -> Turn 9
    res_copse = engine.resolve_corner("silverstone", "Copse")
    assert res_copse["resolved"] is True
    assert res_copse["turn_number"] == 9

    # Spa Eau Rouge -> Turn 2
    res_eau_rouge = engine.resolve_corner("spa", "Eau Rouge")
    assert res_eau_rouge["resolved"] is True
    assert res_eau_rouge["turn_number"] == 2

    # Monza Ascari -> Turn 8
    res_ascari = engine.resolve_corner("monza", "Ascari")
    assert res_ascari["resolved"] is True
    assert res_ascari["turn_number"] == 8

    # Interlagos Senna S -> Turn 1
    res_senna_s = engine.resolve_corner("interlagos", "Senna S")
    assert res_senna_s["resolved"] is True
    assert res_senna_s["turn_number"] == 1

    # Unknown corner
    res_unknown = engine.resolve_corner("suzuka", "unknown_corner_alias_xyz")
    assert res_unknown["resolved"] is False
    assert res_unknown.get("unknown_corner") is True
    assert "hint" in res_unknown


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 3: Telemetry Agent Era Boundary & Corner Hinting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_telemetry_agent_era_boundary_and_unknown_corner():
    """Verify TelemetryAgent blocks pre-2023 telemetry and handles unknown corners."""
    agent = get_telemetry_agent()

    # Pre-2023 boundary check
    res_2021 = agent.compare_corners(
        year=2021,
        grand_prix="Brazil",
        session_type="Qualifying",
        driver_1="HAM",
        driver_2="VER",
        corner="Senna S",
    )
    assert res_2021["success"] is False
    assert res_2021.get("era_boundary") is True
    assert "2023–present" in res_2021["message"]

    # Unknown corner handling
    res_unknown_corner = agent.compare_corners(
        year=2024,
        grand_prix="Suzuka",
        session_type="Qualifying",
        driver_1="VER",
        driver_2="NOR",
        corner="mysterious_unnamed_apex",
    )
    assert res_unknown_corner["success"] is False
    assert res_unknown_corner.get("unknown_corner") is True
    assert "hint" in res_unknown_corner


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 4: Historical SQL Agent Brazil 2021 Alias Resolution & ArtifactStore
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_historical_agent_brazil_2021_alias_and_artifact():
    """
    Verify HistoricalSQLAgent resolves 'Brazil' query (stored as 'São Paulo Grand Prix' in 2021),
    executes successfully via zero-row self-correction, and stores results in ArtifactStore.
    """
    agent = get_historical_agent()
    store = get_artifact_store()

    # Query using colloquial 'Brazil' filter
    sql = (
        "SELECT driver_code, constructor_name, finishing_position "
        "FROM v_race_results "
        "WHERE year = 2021 AND lower(grand_prix) LIKE '%brazil%' "
        "ORDER BY finishing_position LIMIT 3"
    )

    res = agent.execute_sql(sql, chart_title="2021 Brazil GP Podium")
    assert res["success"] is True
    assert res["row_count"] >= 3, f"Expected podium finishers, got {res['row_count']}"

    # Verify top 3: HAM, VER, BOT
    podium_drivers = [row["driver_code"] for row in res["sample_rows"][:3]]
    assert "HAM" in podium_drivers
    assert "VER" in podium_drivers

    # Verify dataset was stored in ArtifactStore
    dataset_id = res["dataset_id"]
    assert dataset_id is not None
    record = store.get(dataset_id)
    assert record is not None
    assert len(record["data"]) >= 3
    assert record["metadata"]["domain"] == "historical_sql"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test 5: Presentation Agent VizSpec Generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_presentation_agent_renders_viz_specs():
    """
    Verify PresentationAgent produces valid VizSpec payloads from ArtifactStore:
    - Plotly figure for historical SQL
    - Plotly figure for corner telemetry
    - Web intelligence card for research
    """
    pa = get_presentation_agent()
    store = get_artifact_store()

    # 1. Historical SQL Artifact
    hist_dataset_id = store.put(
        data=[
            {"driver_code": "HAM", "points": 25},
            {"driver_code": "VER", "points": 18},
            {"driver_code": "BOT", "points": 15},
        ],
        metadata={
            "domain": "historical_sql",
            "sql": "SELECT driver_code, points FROM v_race_results",
            "columns": ["driver_code", "points"],
            "chart_title": "Points Distribution",
        },
    )

    spec_hist = pa.render_visualization(
        dataset_id=hist_dataset_id,
        user_query="Who scored points?",
    )
    assert spec_hist["chart_type"] in ("plotly_figure", "table")
    assert spec_hist["metadata"]["domain"] == "historical_sql"

    # 2. Corner Telemetry Artifact
    dummy_corner_figure = {
        "data": [{"x": [0, 100, 200], "y": [250, 120, 280], "type": "scatter", "name": "VER"}],
        "layout": {"title": "Copse Corner Speed", "paper_bgcolor": "#0B0F17"},
    }
    telemetry_dataset_id = store.put(
        data={
            "chart_spec": dummy_corner_figure,
            "metadata": {
                "domain": "telemetry",
                "year": 2024,
                "grand_prix": "British Grand Prix",
                "session_name": "Qualifying",
                "mode_label": "Copse • Turn 9",
                "drivers": [{"code": "VER", "name": "Red Bull Racing", "color": "#3671C6"}],
            },
        },
        metadata={"domain": "corner_telemetry"},
    )

    spec_tel = pa.render_visualization(
        dataset_id=telemetry_dataset_id,
        domain="corner_telemetry",
    )
    assert spec_tel["chart_type"] == "plotly_figure"
    assert spec_tel["figure"]["layout"]["paper_bgcolor"] == "#0B0F17"

    # 3. Research Artifact -> web_intelligence_card
    research_dataset_id = store.put(
        data={
            "summary": "2026 F1 engine regulations introduce 50% electrical power split and 100% sustainable fuels.",
            "findings": ["MGU-H removed", "100% sustainable fuels", "350kW electric output"],
            "sources": [{"title": "FIA Technical Regulations", "uri": "https://fia.com"}],
        },
        metadata={"domain": "research", "query": "2026 engine regulations"},
    )

    spec_research = pa.render_visualization(
        dataset_id=research_dataset_id,
        domain="research",
        user_query="2026 engine regulations",
    )
    assert spec_research["chart_type"] == "web_intelligence_card"
    assert spec_research["web_card"] is not None
    assert len(spec_research["web_card"]["sources"]) >= 1
    assert "sustainable fuels" in spec_research["web_card"]["summary"]
